status_at_registration: prospective; no quality execution or runtime modification has occurred
scope: Author-written development diagnosis after inspecting v0.12 limitations. Not an independent holdout, a production answer-accuracy result or a latency experiment.
intended_changes: Recognize bounded Chinese completed-aspect declarations without treating a parameter name ending in 次数 as an event-count request. Explicit occurrence/timeline requests retain their old path.
Prefer an authenticated query-covered same-chapter declaration over explicit deferred/nondecision material; do not globally privilege every numeric statement over arbitrary relevant evidence.

Expose bounded-candidate uncertainty: equal-time distinct comparable values are a potential conflict; related text without a comparable declaration is unconfirmed evidence, not a proven negative or generated abstention.

assessment_contract.scope: The diagnostic describes only the inspected bounded candidate pool. It does not claim exhaustive archive coverage, semantic truth or authority. Values are never used to score or boost retrieval.
assessment_contract.relevance_and_explicit_occurrence_contro: not_assessed; do not apply the current-declaration policy to them
assessment_contract.missing: Preserve related original evidence. A no_comparable_declaration flag is not an empty-result requirement.
assessment_contract.conflict: Do not select a true value. Retain both pages when limit/budget admits them; at limit one retain explicit potential-conflict metadata without inventing a second evidence block. No confidence probability is emitted.
assessment_contract.conflict_references: An explicit conflicts list; every entry contains at least two distinct page_ids. Follow-up reads authenticate every referenced full original page inside the exact queried project, including references outside the packed context.

metrics.source_integrity: Reuse the unchanged v012 verify_and_score source/page/coordinate/budget verifier with the new case arguments; independently validate every raw response and exact closed request matrix.
metrics.answerable: Report expected first session and complete source spans separately by mode, budget and limit. Count a first-session improvement only for the registered answerable cases.
metrics.uncertainty: Report each expected assessment status independently of first-source/evidence coverage. Missing baseline diagnostics are recorded as absent; never claim a preexisting detector executed.
metrics.controls: Keep the full source-return payload. Relevance-mode results/context/candidate_count must remain unchanged. Explicit occurrence/history control payloads are compared separately. Foreign-project data cannot appear in returned evidence or conflict page IDs.
metrics.comparability: An unknown exact project never falls back to another book. Identical task/session IDs in two namespaces use different values. Equal-time identical values, different fields and different environments are negative conflict controls.

existing_evidence: Replay the entire unchanged 38-question v012 diagnostic and original engineering/directory gates separately. Never relabel its two known Chinese failures or modify its expected evidence to obtain gains.
retention: Commit protocol/dataset/evaluator before first execution; obtain the controller's remote-freeze confirmation before changing runtime.
Bind actual source HEAD, all runtime bytes, actual imported module/backend, native binary and evaluator bytes before and after each arm. Source commits precede result commits.
Use a new attempt path for every run. Retain all setup errors, failed cases, original responses and control differences. No dropped cases or changed gold after observing outputs.
No timing, universal-superiority or independent-generalization claim is supported by this small authored diagnostic.
